appraisal_events.evidence: — Eh bien ! cela a un chic ! ... — Comment, mais c'est pour rien, c'est donné. On m'avait dit trois fois autant. ... Et montrant à Mme Swann un tour de cou dont celle-ci lui avait fait présent
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme Cottard admires the chic, inexpensive elegance of Mme Swann's refashioned dress and displays a necklace Mme Swann had given her, socially affirming Mme Swann's taste and generosity within the salon conversation.

status_effects.explanation: Mme Swann's taste and generosity are locally affirmed through Mme Cottard's admiring remarks and her display of a gift received from Mme Swann.

ambiguities: The unattributed earlier dialogue turns (praising the dress, questioning its price) are only assigned to Mme Cottard by inference from 'concluait la femme du docteur'; it is not fully certain she spoke every prior line attributed to the interlocutor.
